### Chapter Map * **00:00:00 - 00:03:17 | Setup & Pre-flight Diagnostics:** Browser checks, Twitch stream verification, local environment inspection via `ps aux`, and background node startup. * **00:03:17 - 00:07:37 | Binary Pipeline Configuration & First Run:** Introduction of session goals; starting `office-hours-002-binary` pipeline; pipeline structure inspection; running `demo.py binary raw`. * **00:07:37 - 00:12:05 | Binary Output Verification & Subprocess Integration:** Verifying disk receipts (`job.yaml`, `received.json`) for decompressed gzip payloads; docs walk-through of `subprocess` processor. * **00:12:05 - 00:16:30 | Multiline Regex Pipeline Setup & Stream Handling:** Starting `office-hours-002-multiline`; reviewing regex multiline configuration; running `demo.py multiline feed`; tailing decoded stack trace output. * **00:16:30 - 00:23:45 | Benchmark Harness Execution & CLI Error Remediation:** Running `bench.py` passthrough ladder; debugging `exa` / `ls` formatting conflicts and Python execution errors; reviewing throughput outputs. * **00:23:45 - 00:27:25 | Node Failure Recovery & JSON Transform Benchmark:** Recovering terminated node via `expanso-edge run`; executing `bench.py` JSON-transform workload; verifying sustained rates. * **00:27:25 - 00:29:22 | Benchmarking Repository Overview & Session Wrap-up:** Tour of open-source benchmark documentation, scenario definitions, community channels, and closing remarks. --- ### Time to First Useful Visible Result * **Visible Result:** **00:09:42 - 00:10:43** (Terminal inspection of `runtime/binary-5mf2lox3/received.json` confirming decompressed JSON records generated from binary socket input). * **Cloud UI vs Local Verification:** At 00:09:02, the Cloud Monitoring panel shows active input/output data rates, but the Pipeline Logs tab remains empty (00:09:14–00:09:34). Receipt is verified via local filesystem output. --- ### Prioritized Edit Decisions | # | Action | Time Range (HH:MM:SS) | Boundary Cues (Start / End) | Summary & Rationale | |---|---|---|---|---| | 1 | **CUT** | 00:00:00 – 00:03:17 | *Start:* Opening silent browser navigation.
*End:* "Okay, we're going to get underway here..." | Prunes pre-stream browser tab switching, Twitch audio checks, and diagnostic terminal scrolling. | | 2 | **KEEP** | 00:05:54 – 00:09:05 | *Start:* "I'm going to look at the binary one first..."
*End:* Cloud UI monitoring metrics peak visible. | Core walkthrough of binary pipeline design, socket server input, inline gzip decompression, and broker routing. | | 3 | **COMPRESS** | 00:09:08 – 00:10:30 | *Start:* Navigating to empty Pipeline Log UI.
*End:* Terminal command `more runtime/.../received.json`. | 4x speedup through empty web logs and terminal directory navigation until file display. | | 4 | **KEEP** | 00:10:33 – 00:10:50 | *Start:* Display of `received.json` contents.
*End:* Return to Cloud UI. | Visual proof of decompression and field parsing. | | 5 | **COMPRESS** | 00:11:26 – 00:12:05 | *Start:* Google search for `subprocess expanso`.
*End:* Return to Pipeline UI. | 2x speedup on documentation browser scrolling to keep focus on pipeline execution. | | 6 | **KEEP** | 00:12:30 – 00:15:20 | *Start:* Opening `office-hours-002-multiline` code view.
*End:* Terminal verification of multiline stack traces. | Demonstrates multiline regex boundary detection and structured JSON transformation. | | 7 | **CUT** | 00:13:58 – 00:14:18 | *Start:* `Connection refused` error loop in terminal.
*End:* Cloud UI start button clicked. | Removes dead time caused by sending feed prior to pipeline initialization. | | 8 | **CUT** | 00:21:08 – 00:22:05 | *Start:* `invalid value for --time ` error.
*End:* Switching from `exa` to `ls` aliases. | Removes repetitive CLI syntax errors caused by terminal command alias discrepancies. | | 9 | **CUT** | 00:24:20 – 00:25:55 | *Start:* Edge node disconnection and bootstrap token error.
*End:* Node restored via `expanso-edge run --data-dir`. | Eliminates accidental terminal session termination and directory misconfiguration debugging. | | 10 | **KEEP** | 00:26:58 – 00:27:23 | *Start:* JSON transform benchmark execution starting.
*End:* Final benchmark tabular output displayed. | Shows sustained processing throughput (~5,000 rec/s) on standard hardware. | --- ### Four Strongest Teaching Moments 1. **Binary Stream Handling & In-Line Decompression (00:07:45 – 00:10:50):** Illustrates accepting raw socket feeds over TCP, applying gzip decompression directly in the ingestion layer, and mapping outputs without custom wrapper scripts. 2. **Multiline Stack Trace Aggregation (00:12:35 – 00:15:20):** Demonstrates using regular expression patterns (`re_match`) to group multi-line log events (e.g., Python tracebacks) into coherent JSON records. 3. **Subprocess Processor Architecture (00:11:35 – 00:12:05):** Highlights documentation showing how to pipe streaming pipeline buffers directly into arbitrary external executables without rewriting legacy code. 4. **Performance Benchmarking Methodology (00:17:20 – 00:19:55):** Shows running progressive load ladders (1k to 50k rec/s) to isolate CPU vs. disk I/O bottlenecks. --- ### Capture Framing, Legibility, Webcam, Audio, & Privacy Assessment * **Webcam Obstruction:** The bottom-right webcam overlay routinely covers right-hand terminal outputs and pipeline UI action elements (e.g., 00:09:24, 00:14:48). * **Audio & Pacing:** Host vocal delivery is clear, but long periods of silence occur during background script execution (00:01:04–00:03:00, 00:22:20–00:22:30). * **Visual Clarity:** Browser text and terminal fonts are sharp and legible throughout. * **Sensitive Data Exposure:** Local directory structures and API environment variables (`EXPANSO_API_KEY`, bootstrap tokens) are visible in terminal history and shell prompts (e.g., 00:01:45, 00:24:21). --- ### Concrete Lessons for Next Live Session * **Pre-launch Edge Daemons:** Run persistent background edge nodes in dedicated, detached terminal sessions to prevent accidental process termination when changing directories. * **Standardize Shell Environments:** Use explicit binary paths (`/bin/ls`) rather than shell aliases (`exa`) in demonstration scripts to prevent unexpected parsing failures. * **Reposition Camera Overlay:** Move the webcam feed to the upper-right corner to prevent blocking CLI output and UI control buttons. * **Pre-start Pipelines Before Feeds:** Ensure pipelines are confirmed running in Cloud UI before launching data generators to avoid socket connection errors. --- ### Observation Integrity & Confidence Disclosures * **Visual vs. Narrated Results:** Data receipt was confirmed locally via disk artifacts; the Cloud UI logging view displayed 0 logs during active runs. * **Confidence & Sampling:** Continuous evaluation across all timeline sections (opening, middle, end) with high confidence based on full visual/auditory capture review.
